investigation.findings: Inspected resolveDestinationChatId and sendTextMessage error paths. Multi-device 14-15 digit LIDs were failing with 'No LID for user' when addressed as digits@c.us because WhatsApp Web lacks phone mapping for raw LIDs. Unregistered 10-digit and 12-digit Indian numbers were falling through to default @c.us causing upstream crashes instead of clean 400 rejection.
investigation.root_cause: CONFIRMED: Missing default @lid addressing for 14-15 digit IDs, missing 12-digit (+91...) unregistered phone number rejection, and missing all-zero / dummy number rejection.

changes: src/services/whatsapp-client.js: Added validation for dummy/zero numbers (+910000000000) throwing INVALID_RECIPIENT (400); added clean RECIPIENT_NOT_ON_WHATSAPP (400) for unregistered 12-digit numbers; defaulted 14-15 digit unresolved IDs to @lid; implemented bidirectional @c.us <-> @lid fallback on 'No LID for user' in sendTextMessage.
tests/live/live_manual_text.js: Live verification script testing negative rejection, harness allowlist enforcement, 12-digit resolution, and multi-device LID resolution.

verification.live_script: tests/live/live_manual_text.js passed (negative rejection, harness lockout, 12-digit resolution, LID resolution)
